summary: A 2025 npj Heritage Science paper argues no documents from Khufu's time explain how the pyramid was built; ramp models face physics, ramp-length/space, and spiral-slowness problems; proposes a pulley-like counterweight model.
content: No documents from Khufu's times were found that explain how the pyramid was built. ... The generally accepted theories rely on construction-ramps on which stone blocks mounted on sledges were pulled up the growing pyramid... The appeal of construction-ramp models is their simplicity. ... [But] the use of construction-ramps runs into three major problems: (i) the physics is unfavorable... (ii) The large length of ramps and absence of archeological traces... (iii) The slowness to operate on spiral ramps. ... indicating that ultimately modern-day Egyptologists might agree that the solution to how the Great Pyramid was built is yet to be found.
